# Woodsmith

> Woodsmith is a comprehensive woodworking resource offering expert techniques, project plans, video content, and educational materials for woodworkers of all skill levels.

Woodsmith provides a complete ecosystem for woodworking enthusiasts, including a magazine archive, downloadable project plans, online courses, video tutorials, a retail store, and multimedia content like TV episodes and podcasts. The site emphasizes practical techniques, tool setup, jigs, and workshop organization alongside finished furniture projects.

## Key Topics

- Table Saw Techniques
- Router Techniques
- Woodworking Plans
- Workshop Storage
- Drill Press Jigs
- Tool Setup
- Joinery Techniques
- Shop Organization
- DIY Woodworking
- Hand Tools
- Woodsmith Magazine
- Video Tutorials
- CNC Machining
- Furniture Building
- Woodworking Tips

## Core Resources

- [Woodsmith Homepage](https://www.woodsmith.com): Woodsmith homepage with expert woodworking tips, techniques, and inspiration.
- [Magazine](https://www.woodsmith.com/magazine): Woodsmith magazine subscription and back-issue archive management.
- [Woodsmith Plans](https://www.woodsmith.com/plans): Downloadable DIY woodworking project plans from Woodsmith publications.
- [Online Courses](https://www.woodsmith.com/courses): Online woodworking courses with video tutorials and skill development.
- [Woodsmith Store](https://www.woodsmith.com/store): Woodsmith store selling books, plans, DVDs, and digital products.

## Video & Audio Content

- [Woodsmith Shop TV Show](https://www.woodsmith.com/tv-show): Woodsmith Shop TV episode featuring Hokkaido sideboard furniture build.
- [ShopNotes Podcast](https://www.woodsmith.com/podcast): ShopNotes podcast with weekly woodworking tips and interviews.
- [CNC Basecamp](https://www.woodsmith.com/cnc-basecamp): CNC Basecamp video series on CNC machining techniques and projects.

## Table Saw Techniques

- [Two Jigs, One Table Saw](https://www.woodsmith.com/article/two-jigs-one-table-saw): Table saw jig techniques for dovetail and rabbet joinery.
- [Hassle-Free Crosscut Sled Setup](https://www.woodsmith.com/article/hassle-free-crosscut-sled-setup): Table saw crosscut sled setup and fence alignment guide.
- [Selecting Table Saw Blades](https://www.woodsmith.com/article/selecting-table-saw-blades): Guide to selecting table saw blades by type and application.
- [Table Saw Locking Miter Joint](https://www.woodsmith.com/article/table-saw-locking-miter-joint): Table saw technique for creating locking miter joints.

## Router Techniques

- [Essential Router Table Technique](https://www.woodsmith.com/article/essential-router-table-technique): Router table slot-cutting technique guide for beginners.
- [Router Setup Tricks](https://www.woodsmith.com/article/router-setup-tricks): Router setup tips for bit height adjustment and profile routing.
- [Surfacing Stock By Router Planing](https://www.woodsmith.com/article/surfacing-stock-by-router-planing): Router planing technique guide for stock surfacing and flattening.
- [Rout Custom-Sized Holes](https://www.woodsmith.com/article/custom-sized-holes): Router jig technique for cutting custom-sized and circular holes.
- [Super Simple Router Dado Guide](https://www.woodsmith.com/article/super-simple-router-dado-guide): Router dado guide setup technique for precise edge routing.

## Workshop Tools & Organization

- [The Perfect Organizer for Your Power Tools](https://www.woodsmith.com/article/the-perfect-organizer-for-your-power-tools): DIY power tool organizer project with shop storage solutions.
- [Saw Blade Storage Solutions](https://www.woodsmith.com/article/saw-blade-storage-solutions): DIY saw blade storage and workshop organization project.
- [Drill Press Angle Support](https://www.woodsmith.com/article/drill-press-angle-support): Drill press jig for angled holes and precision drilling.
